description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to shopping cart operations in a grocery backend application, including responses and request payloads for cart items and cart updates.

classes.name: CartDtos
classes.description: Wrapper class containing DTO definitions for cart-related API operations.

methods.name: CartItemResponse
methods.description: Represents details of a cart item, including IDs, product info, and quantity.

methods.name: CartResponse
methods.description: Represents the cart with its items and last updated timestamp.

methods.name: AddToCartRequest
methods.description: Request object for adding an item to the cart, including product ID and quantity.

methods.name: UpdateCartItemRequest
methods.description: Request object for updating the quantity of a cart item.
